'''Viscount''' was a title of [[Noble/Legends|nobility]], with [[Viscountess]] being a [[Gender/Legends|feminine]] equivalent. Before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], male members of the [[House Malreaux|Malreaux family]] on [[Vjun/Legends|Vjun]] were addressed this way. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] the finance minister of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], [[Tardi]], held such title.
